SUBSTRATE BUG — surfaced by origindex ARGUS during the wfd.1 verdict-write (2026-05-24); routed up by user-tier POLYBIUS.

The save-verdict skill fails on Windows git-bash:
- heredoc-with-quoted-EOF blocks (<<'EOF' ... EOF) fail in the skill's invocation pattern.
- /tmp/ resolves differently between git-bash and Python on Windows — a path written by one isn't found by the other.

IMPACT: CAPTAINs (e.g. ARGUS) can't reliably write verdicts via save-verdict on Windows. They work around it, but it is friction + a latent correctness risk (a failed write that reads as success).

FIX DIRECTION: make save-verdict Windows-robust — drop the bash-heredoc-with-quoted-EOF pattern; resolve a portable temp location consistently (don't assume bash /tmp == Python /tmp on Windows); ideally write + read through the same runtime. Verify on a Windows git-bash + Python combo.

RELATED: u--h8q (user-tier) — PowerShell-tool canary. Same class of Windows-shell quirk; a native PowerShell tool would sidestep heredoc/temp-path mismatches. If the canary passes, that may be the broader fix; this skill fix stands regardless.

Tracking both here rather than duplicating into the new calibration epic stoa--7b1. Full evidence: stoa--q3l body + C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\ksge-engine\agents\observation\ksge-eng-5sp\consolidated-substrate-friction.md

NEW OCCURRENCE (2026-06-01, Arc 52 ARC A): CAPTAIN_ARGUS hit this authoring its verdict via save-verdict on Windows Git-Bash — apostrophes in the body break the heredoc EVEN under a quoted <<'EOF' delimiter; required several retries, worked around by authoring the entire verdict apostrophe-free. Likely the SAME root cause as this ticket's heredoc-EOF failure (apostrophe handling is a facet of the Git-Bash heredoc bug). Adds N+1 empirical evidence + a specific failure facet (apostrophe-in-quoted-heredoc) to the existing repro. Surfaced by PLINY_the-stoa as an Arc-52 sideband; correctly OUT of Arc 52 (prevention-layer) scope. CONCRETE NEXT STEP when this ticket is worked: repro apostrophe-in-quoted-heredoc on Windows git-bash; candidate fix = switch save-verdict's write mechanism off heredoc (printf/Write-tool) OR document an apostrophe-free CAPTAIN verdict-authoring discipline.
